name: Dairy
intro: If you supply milk to homes every day and collect the money later, the small amounts add up. BolCash helps you keep a separate record for each customer.

uses.title: Record for each customer
uses.body: Know what each customer owes you, without checking a notebook.

uses.title: Payments received
uses.body: Mark each payment when you get it, so the balance stays right.

uses.title: Supplier dues
uses.body: Keep track of what you owe your milk suppliers, and note it when you pay.
